definitions.summary_weighting: Each reference unit has equal weight; rows are paired to raw within the same unit.
definitions.NDVI_proxy: Fraction of optically valid original above-ground (>2m) candidates with sampled NDVI>0.3. Vegetation/canopy observation proxy, not tree GT or obstruction fraction.
definitions.roof_complexity: Compiled reference roof patch count after only explicit coplanar source-plane merging; this is not a verified architectural roof-type label.
definitions.calendar_alignment: From recorded NAIP tile names/dates, LiDAR metadata date range, and exact per-reference survey date. Same year does not prove contemporaneous observations.
definitions.reference_internal_breaklines: Evaluator internal slope-break/step lines; DC depends on unverified nominal-Z thresholds.
definitions.strata_policy: Fixed descriptive bins, no cohort exclusion, no target-dependent tuning, no threshold selected from outcomes.
definitions.uncertainty: Use independent audit cluster bootstrap. These stratified summaries are descriptive, not additional independent cities or blocks.
